title: Front Post and Back Post
description: Use post stitches to create ribbing, texture, and raised columns in your crochet fabric.

content.summary: Instead of working into the top loops, wrap the stitch around the post from the front or back.
content.whyItMatters: Front post and back post stitches create texture that regular flat stitches cannot, especially for cuffs, hats, and borders.
steps: Yarn over like a double crochet.
For a front post stitch, insert the hook from front to back to front around the post.
For a back post stitch, insert from back to front to back around the post.
Pull up a loop and finish the stitch like a double crochet.
Alternate front and back post stitches to build ribbing.
content.practice: Work one row of front post double crochet and one row of alternating front and back post double crochet.
commonMistakes: Accidentally inserting into the top loops instead of around the post.
Twisting the fabric by skipping posts while alternating.
